truth_type: compatibility-patched NORI ns-3 to O-RAN SC M Setup plus bounded user-plane smoke

oransc_runtime_recovery.action: ordered E2Term then E2Mgr rollout refresh after repeated compatibility tests

compatibility_repairs.repair: bind NORI to the ns-O-RAN E2Sim archive already validated against release M instead of the newer local NORI E2Sim archive
use the same three-byte PLMN compatibility profile as the official ns-O-RAN examples
demote an unconditional per-scheduling-iteration diagnostic to debug level so the example has bounded console output
restore Simulator::Stop(simTime) so the requested experiment window terminates cleanly
schedule the built-in NoriSlicingHelper slice-to-RNTI map before traffic starts; without it the RL scheduler has zero schedulable slices

discarded_attempts: the default endpoint 10.244.0.246:36422 did not target the current kind NodePort
the newer /usr/local/lib/libe2sim.a established SCTP and sent a 446-byte Setup Request, but O-RAN SC M did not construct a RAN inventory name or return Setup Response
the first bounded RL smoke transmitted packets but received none because the example never installed the slice-to-RNTI map required by NrRLMacSchedulerOfdma
interpretation: After two simulator-side compatibility repairs and three example-operability repairs, NORI established SCTP, decoded a successful O-RAN SC M response accepting KPM function 200 and RC function 300, and completed bounded medium-load and saturation RL user-plane smokes with exit status 0 and nonzero delivery.
claim_boundary: This is compatibility, executable-lifecycle, and user-plane smoke evidence. The two 10-second diagnostics are single runs on a repaired example, so no KPM subscription, indication, RC action, comparative scheduler gain, repeated stability result, or over-the-air path is claimed.
